checklist.title: Attempt contract creation at address with non-empty storage to violate EIP-7610 storage check invariant
checklist.detection_procedure: Design a test case to violate the invariant that contract creation MUST be reverted for addresses with non-empty storage. Create a scenario where an address has zero nonce, empty code, but non-empty storage (pre-EIP-161 residual state). Attempt contract creation (CREATE/CREATE2) targeting this address. Verify system correctly reverts creation with behavior equivalent to invalid opcode.
executable_checks: Identify or create a mainnet address with residual storage (zero nonce, empty code, non-empty storage)
Construct a CREATE2 operation targeting this address with specific salt
Submit transaction attempting contract deployment to this address
Verify creation is reverted immediately
Confirm revert behavior matches invalid opcode semantics (all gas consumed, state rolled back)
Verify no code is deployed at the target address
Check that storage remains untouched post-attempt
checklist.notes: Tests EIP-7610 new rule for storage check. Property covers ACTION-CHECK-STORAGE node and EDGE-STORAGE-CHECK-FAIL, EDGE-STORAGE-REVERT edges. Related to AMB-EIP7610-01. Formal verification approach: prove storage check cannot be bypassed through any state transition path.

checklist.title: Bypass pre-condition blocking deployment at addresses with residual storage from pre-EIP-161
checklist.detection_procedure: Test the pre-condition that addresses with residual pre-EIP-161 storage MUST be blocked from deployment. Identify one of the 28 known mainnet addresses with residual storage. Craft a transaction to deploy code at this address using CREATE2 with a calculated salt. Attempt to bypass the storage check through edge cases: transaction ordering, EIP-1014 address collision, or EVM state manipulation.
executable_checks: Select a known residual storage address from mainnet (e.g., one of the 28 identified addresses)
Calculate CREATE2 salt to target this specific address
Attempt deployment with edge case parameters: zero-length init code, self-destruct in constructor
Verify deployment is blocked at validation stage
Confirm STATE-DEPLOYMENT-BLOCKED is reached
Test with different transaction types (legacy, EIP-2930, EIP-1559)
Verify no code can be injected regardless of approach
checklist.notes: Tests EIP-7610 protection for historical residual addresses. Property covers STATE-ADDRESS-PARTIAL-RESIDUAL node and EDGE-RESIDUAL-DEPLOY, EDGE-DEPLOY-BLOCKED-RESIDUAL edges. Critical for preventing attacks on the 28 known mainnet addresses per ASSUM-EIP7610-01.

checklist.title: Bypass storage trie inspection mechanism to allow deployment at non-empty storage address
checklist.detection_procedure: Test the pre-condition that storage check MUST correctly inspect storage trie for non-zero values. Attempt to bypass storage detection through: (1) deleted storage slots (set to zero but trie node remains), (2) storage slot boundary conditions (max slot number), (3) storage trie implementation quirks across clients. Verify all implementations correctly detect at least one non-zero storage slot.
executable_checks: Create test address with single storage slot set to non-zero value
Delete storage slot by setting to zero (SSTORE with zero value)
Verify trie structure correctly reports storage state
Attempt CREATE2 deployment at address with deleted-but-present storage
Test edge case: address with storage at slot 2^256-1
Verify storage check cannot be bypassed via trie manipulation
Cross-client validation: test on Geth, Nethermind, Besu, Erigon for consistency
checklist.notes: Tests storage trie inspection correctness per AMB-EIP7610-01 and ASSUM-EIP7610-02. Property covers ACTION-CHECK-STORAGE node and EDGE-STORAGE-CHECK-FAIL, EDGE-STORAGE-CHECK-PASS edges. Critical for EIP-7610 consensus compatibility.

checklist.title: Verify incorrect values returned by block environment opcodes after execution
checklist.detection_procedure: Test post-condition that COINBASE, TIMESTAMP, NUMBER, PREVRANDAO, GASLIMIT, CHAINID return correct block environment values. Deploy contract invoking each opcode and compare returned values against block header data. Test for: (1) value corruption, (2) wrong block referenced (parent instead of current), (3) PC not incremented correctly, (4) stack position errors.
executable_checks: Deploy test contract executing COINBASE (0x41), verify stack[0] == block.coinbase
Execute TIMESTAMP (0x42), verify stack[0] == block.timestamp
Execute NUMBER (0x43), verify stack[0] == block.number
Execute PREVRANDAO (0x44), verify stack[0] == block.prevrandao (post-Merge)
Execute GASLIMIT (0x45), verify stack[0] == block.gaslimit
Execute CHAINID (0x46), verify stack[0] == chainid
Verify PC incremented correctly after each opcode (PC = PC + 1)
Test opcodes in nested call contexts (CALL, DELEGATECALL) for value consistency
checklist.notes: Tests Cancun block opcode correctness. Property covers ACTION-COINBASE-EXECUTE through ACTION-CHAINID-EXECUTE nodes and completion edges. Related to ASSUM-CANCUN-BLOCK-01. Falsification approach: prove return values can diverge from block environment.

checklist.title: Trigger stack overflow by executing push-only block opcodes when stack size == 1024
checklist.detection_procedure: Test pre-condition that push-only block opcodes (COINBASE, TIMESTAMP, NUMBER, PREVRANDAO, GASLIMIT, CHAINID) MUST trigger stack overflow when stack size >= 1024. Construct contract that fills stack to 1023 elements, then executes block opcode. Verify StackOverflowError is raised and transaction reverts.
executable_checks: Deploy contract with bytecode that pushes 1023 elements onto stack
Execute COINBASE (0x41) as 1024th stack operation
Verify transaction reverts with stack overflow error
Confirm no value is pushed to stack
Verify STATE-STACK-OVERFLOW is reached
Test with each block opcode: TIMESTAMP, NUMBER, PREVRANDAO, GASLIMIT, CHAINID
Verify error handling consistent across all push-only block opcodes
checklist.notes: Tests EVM stack limit enforcement for block opcodes. Property covers ACTION-VALIDATE-STACK-PUSH node and EDGE-VALIDATE-PUSH-STACK, EDGE-PUSH-STACK-OK, EDGE-PUSH-OVERFLOW edges. Falsification: attempt to push beyond stack limit.

checklist.title: Validate transaction payload from untrusted user before EIP-3651 access list initialization
checklist.detection_procedure: BOUNDARY GUARD: Transaction payload enters via JSON-RPC from untrusted user (EXT-USER-JSON-RPC → EDGE-TX-FROM-USER). Must validate transaction structure before access list initialization. Test: (1) Malformed transaction encoding (invalid RLP), (2) Missing required fields (nonce, gasPrice, gas, to, value, data), (3) Invalid signature (wrong v,r,s), (4) Signature not recoverable to valid sender address.

Submit transaction missing mandatory field (e.g., no nonce)
Submit transaction with invalid signature (manipulated r,s values)
Submit transaction with v value not in valid range (27/28 or EIP-155)
Verify all invalid transactions rejected BEFORE access list initialization
Confirm STATE-TX-RECEIVED validation occurs at boundary
Verify sender address recovery fails gracefully for invalid signatures
Test with various transaction types: legacy, EIP-2930, EIP-1559

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TX-RECEIVED correctly captures transaction payload structure

Verify STATE-TX-RECEIVED stores complete transaction data

checklist.title: Prove COINBASE warming does not apply to specific transaction type
checklist.detection_procedure: Test invariant that COINBASE warming applies uniformly to all transaction types. Attempt to find transaction type where COINBASE is not warmed: legacy (type 0), EIP-2930 (type 1), EIP-1559 (type 2). Deploy contract accessing COINBASE via BALANCE or EXTCODESIZE and measure gas cost. Verify warm access cost (~100 gas) charged for all types.

checklist.title: Validate consensus layer withdrawal data before execution layer processing

Semi-trusted source (JWT authenticated) but content requires validation. checklist.title: Cause withdrawal index non-monotonicity or duplication
checklist.detection_procedure: Test invariant that withdrawal indices are monotonically increasing and never duplicate. Verify all cases trigger exception.
